title: l1qw.3.7.6.1: C: SCHC peer_table keyed by full signing identity + generation
description: Implement the peer_table data structure keyed by (local_signing_key, remote_signing_key, remote_key_generation). Each entry owns sender/receiver/tombstone/admission-floor state. Opaque key generation from authenticated DIO evidence. No hot-path allocation. Bounded capacity with fail-closed on exhaustion. This is the core data structure for spec/03-adaptation.md 5.6.
